summary.zh: 先阻止伤势继续扩大，再考虑把生命补满。
summary.en: Stop ongoing damage before trying to refill health.

rules.zh: 受伤后除了立即损失生命，还可能持续失血。玩家在移动、战斗和包扎之间选择时机；处理伤口可以止住持续损失，却不会立即恢复全部伤势。
rules.en: An injury may cause both immediate damage and ongoing blood loss. Choose when to move, fight or bandage. Treatment stops further loss without instantly healing the original wound.

decisions.zh: 原地包扎有被打断风险，先跑又会继续失血。
decisions.en: Bandaging now risks interruption; running first costs more blood.

decisions.zh: 材料有限时，应先处理流血最快的伤口。
decisions.en: With limited supplies, prioritize the fastest bleeding wound.

effect.zh: 快失血强调即时避险；慢失血允许艰难返程。
effect.en: Fast bleeding demands immediate shelter; slow bleeding permits difficult retreats.

effect.zh: 允许保留部分进度会鼓励分段治疗；重置进度更需要完整安全窗口。
effect.en: Partial progress permits staged treatment; resets demand a full safe window.

implementation.zh: 开放伤口可能出血，布条或绷带可包扎；颈部伤口尤其危险，止血不等于治愈感染或骨折。
implementation.en: Open wounds can bleed and be bandaged with strips or bandages. Neck wounds are especially dangerous; stopping bleeding does not cure infection or fractures.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：街道上的火焰与僵尸群展示危险场景；没有显示治疗操作。
observation.en: System reference: Fire and a zombie crowd establish a dangerous street scene; treatment is not shown. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 不同伤口的出血程度不同，医生照料伤口能阻止出血；生命安全和恢复行动能力是两个阶段。
implementation.en: Injuries differ in bleeding rate. Medical tending stops bleeding, while recovering function remains a separate process.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：殖民地布局提供救治场景，画面不能证明某个角色正在出血。
observation.en: System reference: the colony provides care context, not proof that a character is bleeding.

contrast.zh: 僵尸毁灭工程要求玩家亲自给身体部位包扎；环世界把救治交给可调度的医生与病床。
contrast.en: Project Zomboid asks for direct body-part treatment; RimWorld turns care into doctor and bed scheduling.

combination.zh: 设计提案：绷带也占背包重量，出发时要在多带急救物资和多带战利品之间取舍；撤退时减轻负重可以缩短带伤暴露的时间。
combination.en: Design proposal: bandages consume carrying capacity, so extra aid supplies compete with loot space; dropping weight on retreat reduces the time spent exposed while injured.

setup.zh: 演示设定：生命剩六格，每轮流血一格，出口还有四轮。
setup.en: Example: six health, one lost per turn, four turns to the exit.

action.en: Spend a turn bandaging in a room.

result.zh: 生命降到五格，但之后不再持续下降。
result.en: Health drops to five, then stops draining.

next.zh: 带着伤势撤离，之后再恢复生命。

firstStep.zh: 一个出血状态、一个可中断包扎动作和一条撤退路线就能验证。
firstStep.en: Test one bleeding state, an interruptible bandage action and a retreat route.

pitfall.zh: 大量伤口类型会分散核心判断；先只做轻重两级出血。
pitfall.en: Many wound types obscure the decision; begin with two bleed severities.

test.zh: 记录玩家能否解释为什么先包扎或先移动。
test.en: Check whether players can explain treating first versus moving first.
